Completely show the full body of the character in T-pose. Standing upright, facing forward. Arms raise horizontally at shoulder height. Palms facing down, remove handheld objects but keep hand-worn equipment and accessories. Legs straight, feet shoulder-width apart. Keep natural body proportions and anatomy. Front view, neutral background.
A new character: an amateur football player, a Japanese American man in his late sixties, a tough old tackler who has seen it all: short, compact and stocky, a man's flat broad chest, a thick straight waist with a small firm paunch, thick smooth hairless forearms and short strong slightly bowed legs, wearing old navy blue sneakers. His head and face are exactly those of the old man in image[1]: light golden-tan skin, narrow dark eyes under straight grey eyebrows, a broad lined face, grey hair combed back, a grey moustache and a hard closed-mouth stare. Only the head is taken from image[1], not the body. He wears exactly the same kit as the man in image[2] and has a man's body like his, only smaller and with less belly, in exactly the same hand-sculpted clay art style, lighting and background as image[2]. Full body, front view, standing upright in a T-pose with arms straight out to the sides, palms down, fingers slightly apart, legs slightly apart. Stylized 3D cartoon character, an everyday person rather than an athlete, with a slightly big head, slightly oversized hands and shoes, smooth matte clay look, a detailed and expressive face, sculpted chunky hair, soft folds in the clothes, and well-defined hands, elbows and knees. The kit: a loose short-sleeved football jersey in plain near-white, pants ending just below the knee in plain mid grey, long socks in plain dark grey, each one flat colour with no logos, no numbers, no text, no stripes and no trim in another colour. Bare arms and bare hands, no helmet, no pads. Mouth closed. Matte, no gloss. Flat, even lighting. Single isolated figure on a plain flat blue-grey background, no floor shadow, no props.
